info.title: StockQuant Research Automation V3.2 submission coordination API

get.summary: Return exact candidate bytes only to the dedicated validation Worker for a submitted PromotionRequest

parameters.name: x-stockquant-service-id
parameters.description: Optional consistency check; the Bearer token is the authenticated identity.

200.description: Request-bound published candidate bytes and immutable reference

401.description: Dedicated validation Worker Bearer identity is required

403.description: Caller identity or route scope is not allowed

404.description: PromotionRequest has not passed submission gate

409.description: Stored bytes do not match immutable artifact metadata

503.description: Persistent submission and artifact stores are unavailable

post.summary: Prepare and submit an immutable PromotionRequest only after the authoritative exact V3.1 run is accepted

200.description: V3.1 gate is incomplete; no Quant request was made

201.description: PromotionRequest was persisted by Quant after an accepted exact V3.1 gate

202.description: Submission outcome is unknown and requires exact-key reconciliation

401.description: Authenticated platform service identity is required

403.description: Caller identity or route scope is not allowed

503.description: Required storage, identity, or V3.1 gate service is unavailable
